name: Answers from the matching knowledge article and cites it
description: Three passages are retrieved for a refund question. The draft must answer with the refund policy's facts, cite that article, and not cite the unrelated ones.

input.subject: Refund for order #2281
input.body: Hi, I returned my order last week. How long until I get my money back?

knowledge.title: Refund policy
knowledge.content: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the return. You get an email when the refund is sent.

knowledge.title: Shipping times
knowledge.content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 days. Express shipping arrives in 1 to 2 days.

knowledge.title: Resetting your password
knowledge.content: Use the 'Forgot password' link on the sign-in page. The reset link is valid for 1 hour.

mock.text:
Hi Sam, thanks for sending the order back. Once we've received the return, the refund goes to your original payment method within 5 business days, and you'll get an email when it's sent.
[sources: K1]
